# T-2: Use cache in Agent.call

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Integrate cache lookup and save behavior into Agent.call while preserving existing miss-path invocation behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 is satisfied by skipping provider invocation on the second identical successful call within the same active flow current-spec scope.
- R3 is satisfied by misses for changed provider/profile/prompt identity fields.
- R4 is satisfied by not saving empty, failed, or parse-failed responses.
- R7 is satisfied by keeping existing retry, parse, stdin fallback, logging, and returned text behavior for misses.

## Implementation Notes
Place lookup after provider/profile resolution and before provider spawn. Save only after the existing invocation path returns a successful non-empty parsed text result.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local tests with `// spec: R1 ...`, `// spec: R3 ...`, `// spec: R4 ...`, and `// spec: R7 ...` headers using a test provider command whose invocation count can be observed.
